---
title: "IRFinder vs rMATS RI concordance (diagnostic only, revision/file-changes/02-4-irfinder-concordance.Rmd.md)"
output: html_document
---

```{r, setup}
# Diagnostic-only stage: compares rMATS RI PSI (02-3 output) against IRFinder
# IRratio for the same retained introns. Does NOT modify 02-3's output and does
# NOT feed into 03 - purely a side report answering reviewer must-do #2
# ("use IRFinder for RI or justify rMATS"). No override/replace logic here by
# design - see revision/file-changes/02-4-irfinder-concordance.Rmd.md.
library(data.table)
library(GenomicRanges)
library(pbmcapply)
set.seed(getOption("EpiATLAS_AS_SEED", 42L))

this_transcript_filter <- Sys.getenv(
  "TRANSCRIPT_FILTER",
  unset = getOption("EpiATLAS_AS_PRIMARY_FILTER", "biotype_filtered")
)

dir.create("qc/distributions", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
sanity_csv <- "qc/sanity_summary.csv"
append_sanity <- function(check_name, status, value, threshold, notes = "") {
  new_row <- data.table(
    check_name = check_name,
    status = status,
    value = value,
    threshold = threshold,
    notes = notes
  )
  if (file.exists(sanity_csv)) {
    # upsert by check_name: drop any prior row for this check before writing
    # the new one, so sanity_summary.csv doesn't accumulate stale/duplicate
    # rows across reruns (append=TRUE never truncated -> the file only grew).
    existing <- fread(sanity_csv)
    existing <- existing[check_name != new_row$check_name]
    fwrite(rbind(existing, new_row, fill = TRUE), sanity_csv)
  } else {
    fwrite(new_row, sanity_csv)
  }
}
```

```{r, load-rmats-ri}
# 02-3's RI output for this filter: event_RI.psi (wide, first col = suppa_id,
# rownames-as-column so fread auto-names it "V1"), event_RI.psi.annot (ID,
# geneSymbol, suppa_id - superset before percentile filtering, join by
# suppa_id not ID/row-position).
ri_dir <- sprintf("splicing_analysis/rmats/%s", this_transcript_filter)
psi_wide <- fread(file.path(ri_dir, "event_RI.psi"))
setnames(psi_wide, 1, "suppa_id")
psi_long <- melt(
  psi_wide,
  id.vars = "suppa_id",
  variable.name = "uuid",
  value.name = "psi",
  variable.factor = FALSE
)[!is.na(psi)]

cat(sprintf(
  "Loaded %d RI events x %d samples (%d non-NA psi cells) for %s\n",
  nrow(psi_wide),
  ncol(psi_wide) - 1L,
  nrow(psi_long),
  this_transcript_filter
))
```

```{r, parse-ri-coordinates}
# RI suppa_id: gene;RI:chr:e1:s2-e2:s3:strand -> retained intron = [s2, e2].
# Simple string split, no need for 03's full event_gr machinery (that also
# handles SE upstream/downstream introns, irrelevant here).
ri_coords <- unique(psi_long[, .(suppa_id)])
ri_coords[,
  c("gene", "et", "chr", "e1", "s2e2", "s3", "strand") := tstrsplit(
    suppa_id,
    "[:;]",
    fixed = FALSE
  )
]
ri_coords[, c("s2", "e2") := tstrsplit(s2e2, "-", type.convert = TRUE)]
ri_coords[, `:=`(e1 = NULL, s2e2 = NULL, s3 = NULL, gene = NULL, et = NULL)]

# Coordinate-system check against IRFinder's raw output (verified empirically
# 2026-07-12 against 2 independent real introns, both strands): IRFinder's
# Start matches our s2 EXACTLY (no offset - not 0-based BED as first assumed),
# but IRFinder's End is consistently s2/e2's e2 MINUS 1 (IRFinder reports the
# intron as a half-open-at-the-end interval, or an off-by-one in its own
# annotation extraction - the "why" doesn't matter, the empirical transform
# does: match on (chr, s2, e2-1, strand), not (chr, s2, e2, strand).
ri_coords[, e2_irfinder := e2 - 1L]

ri_gr <- ri_coords[, GRanges(
  seqnames = chr,
  ranges = IRanges(start = s2, end = e2),
  strand = strand
)]
names(ri_gr) <- ri_coords$suppa_id

cat(sprintf("%d unique RI intron coordinates parsed\n", length(ri_gr)))
```

```{r, pre-filter-candidates}
# Pre-Procedure-2-filter candidate RI event set (event_RI.psi.annot) - a
# SUPERSET of the ~2085 events actually modelled (02-3's percentile filter
# drops some). All of this is rMATS output - no SUPPA2 data is used anywhere
# in this pipeline; `suppa_id` is just the column-naming convention the
# pipeline's own code applies to rMATS's event coordinates via sprintf(), not
# evidence SUPPA2 was ever run. Used below to distinguish, among introns
# IRFinder finds real signal at but rMATS never modelled: (a) rMATS DID
# consider this intron as an RI candidate but Procedure-2 filtered it out
# (recoverable by relaxing the filter) vs (b) rMATS's structural annotation
# never considered this intron an RI candidate AT ALL (no alternative
# spliced-out isoform in the annotation - structurally invisible to rMATS,
# not a coverage artifact).
annot_dt <- fread(file.path(ri_dir, "event_RI.psi.annot"))
annot_dt[,
  c("gene", "et", "chr", "e1", "s2e2", "s3", "strand") := tstrsplit(
    suppa_id, "[:;]", fixed = FALSE
  )
]
annot_dt[, c("s2", "e2") := tstrsplit(s2e2, "-", type.convert = TRUE)]
annot_dt[, e2_irfinder := e2 - 1L]
annot_key_dt <- unique(annot_dt[, .(
  match_key = paste(chr, s2, e2_irfinder, strand, sep = "_"),
  suppa_id
)])
cat(sprintf(
  "%d candidate RI events pre-Procedure-2-filter (vs %d post-filter, modelled)\n",
  nrow(annot_key_dt), nrow(ri_coords)
))
```

```{r, event-metrics}
# Per-event intrinsic metrics, independent of which IRFinder tree we compare
# against - used below to check WHY some events are/aren't found by IRFinder
# (is it just coverage? intron length? PSI level/variability?), not just
# report a bare found/not-found count.
jc_dt <- fread(file.path(ri_dir, "event_RI.jc.csv.gz"))
jc_dt[, coverage := IJC + SJC]
event_coverage <- jc_dt[,
  .(mean_coverage = mean(coverage, na.rm = TRUE)),
  by = suppa_id
]

event_metrics <- psi_long[,
  .(n_samples = .N, mean_psi = mean(psi), sd_psi = sd(psi)),
  by = suppa_id
]
event_metrics[ri_coords, on = "suppa_id", intron_length := i.e2 - i.s2 + 1L]
event_metrics[event_coverage, on = "suppa_id", mean_coverage := i.mean_coverage]

cat(sprintf(
  "Computed intrinsic metrics for %d RI events\n",
  nrow(event_metrics)
))
```

```{r, analyze-tree-function}
# Run the full IRFinder-vs-rMATS comparison for ONE reference tree. Returns
# everything needed for the event/cell-level breakdown, concordance, and
# per-event category assignment - called once per tree below (both
# `annotation` and `TSL12`, not just a guessed mapping) so we can compare
# them directly instead of assuming which one is right.
ri_keys <- ri_coords[, paste(chr, s2, e2_irfinder, strand, sep = "_")]
ri_key_dt <- data.table(match_key = ri_keys, suppa_id = ri_coords$suppa_id)
setkey(ri_key_dt, match_key)
rmats_uuids <- unique(psi_long$uuid)

analyze_tree <- function(irfinder_tree) {
  irfinder_dir <- sprintf(
    "/nfs/data/IHEC/RNAseq/irfinder/%s/irfinder_output",
    irfinder_tree
  )
  uuid_dirs <- list.dirs(irfinder_dir, recursive = FALSE)
  uuid_dirs <- uuid_dirs[basename(uuid_dirs) %in% rmats_uuids]
  cat(sprintf(
    "\n=== IRFinder tree: %s (%d overlapping sample dirs) ===\n",
    irfinder_tree,
    length(uuid_dirs)
  ))

  # Fast per-sample filter: build a "chr_start_end_strand" key set ONCE, then
  # for each sample's genome-wide IRFinder file, keep only rows matching a
  # key in that set (before rbinding across samples) - keeps peak memory
  # small even though IRFinder scores ~250k introns/sample genome-wide. Does
  # NOT pre-filter by confidence - keeps every matched row + a `high_conf`
  # flag so "annotated at all" vs "high-confidence" vs "used in concordance"
  # can be reported separately.
  # Reads the FULL genome-wide table once per sample (unavoidable - IRFinder
  # scores ~250k introns/sample, no per-intron index) and returns TWO slices
  # from the same in-memory read (no second file read): (1) rows matching our
  # rMATS RI candidate coordinates (as before), and (2) genome-wide introns
  # NOT in that set but with real, high-confidence retention signal (IRratio
  # > 0.1) - candidates for "IRFinder finds retention rMATS never called".
  read_one_sample <- function(d) {
    f <- file.path(d, "IRFinder-IR-nondir.txt")
    if (!file.exists(f)) {
      return(NULL)
    }
    dt <- fread(f, showProgress = FALSE)
    # Start/End used AS-IS (raw, no offset) - matched against s2/e2_irfinder
    # (see coordinate-system note in parse-ri-coordinates above).
    dt[, match_key := paste(Chr, Start, End, Strand, sep = "_")]
    dt[, uuid := basename(d)]
    # high-confidence per file-changes/scripts/irfinder_array.sh.md policy:
    # Warnings == "-", Name tag clean/known-exon only, never
    # anti-near/anti-over (antisense-confounded).
    dt[,
      high_conf := Warnings == "-" &
        grepl("clean|known-exon", Name) &
        !grepl("anti-near|anti-over", Name)
    ]
    in_rmats <- dt$match_key %in% ri_key_dt$match_key
    list(
      matched = dt[in_rmats, .(match_key, uuid, IRratio, high_conf)],
      unmatched_signal = dt[
        !in_rmats & high_conf == TRUE & IRratio > 0.1,
        .(match_key, uuid, IRratio, Name)
      ]
    )
  }

  raw_results <- Filter(
    Negate(is.null),
    # mc.cores fallback lowered 4L->2L (2026-07-15): forked workers each carry a
    # copy of the parent's memory, and this job OOM-killed at mem_mb=8000 with
    # 4-way forking on real biotype_filtered data. Nothing in this pipeline ever
    # sets options(mc.cores=), so this fallback is the actual value used
    # regardless of Snakemake's `threads:` allocation -- that resource field was
    # previously just documentation drift, not a real cap.
    pbmclapply(uuid_dirs, read_one_sample, mc.cores = min(8L, getOption("mc.cores", 2L)))
  )
  irfinder_all <- rbindlist(lapply(raw_results, `[[`, "matched"))
  irfinder_all[ri_key_dt, on = "match_key", suppa_id := i.suppa_id]
  irfinder_hc <- irfinder_all[high_conf == TRUE]

  # Genome-wide introns with recurring real signal (>=3 samples, matching the
  # per-event min-sample threshold used elsewhere) but NO rMATS RI candidate
  # at that exact coordinate at all.
  irfinder_unmatched <- rbindlist(lapply(raw_results, `[[`, "unmatched_signal"))
  irfinder_only_agg <- irfinder_unmatched[, .(
    n_samples_signal = .N,
    mean_IRratio = mean(IRratio),
    gene_name = Name[1]
  ), by = match_key]
  irfinder_only_recurring <- irfinder_only_agg[n_samples_signal >= 3]
  irfinder_only_recurring[,
    in_pre_filter_candidates := match_key %in% annot_key_dt$match_key
  ]
  n_filtered_by_proc2 <- sum(irfinder_only_recurring$in_pre_filter_candidates)
  n_not_suppa_candidate <- sum(!irfinder_only_recurring$in_pre_filter_candidates)

  cat(sprintf(
    "IRFinder-only introns (>=3 samples, IRratio>0.1, no rMATS RI candidate at all): %d\n",
    nrow(irfinder_only_recurring)
  ))
  cat(sprintf(
    "  Of those: %d WERE a pre-Procedure-2-filter rMATS candidate (rMATS considered it, then filtered it out)\n",
    n_filtered_by_proc2
  ))
  cat(sprintf(
    "  Of those: %d were NEVER an rMATS RI candidate at all (no alternative spliced isoform in the annotation)\n",
    n_not_suppa_candidate
  ))

  # event-level counts
  n_events_total <- length(ri_gr)
  n_events_any_annotation <- uniqueN(irfinder_all$suppa_id)
  n_events_high_conf <- uniqueN(irfinder_hc$suppa_id)

  # per-event category, used for the stratified plots below
  event_category <- data.table(suppa_id = ri_coords$suppa_id)
  event_category[, category := "rmats_only"]
  event_category[
    suppa_id %in% unique(irfinder_all$suppa_id),
    category := "annotated_never_confident"
  ]
  event_category[
    suppa_id %in% unique(irfinder_hc$suppa_id),
    category := "high_conf"
  ]
  event_category[,
    category := factor(
      category,
      levels = c("rmats_only", "annotated_never_confident", "high_conf")
    )
  ]

  # cell-level breakdown
  irfinder_hc_key <- irfinder_hc[, .(suppa_id, uuid, IRratio)]
  setkey(irfinder_hc_key, suppa_id, uuid)
  psi_key <- copy(psi_long)
  setkey(psi_key, suppa_id, uuid)
  both <- merge(
    psi_key,
    irfinder_hc_key,
    by = c("suppa_id", "uuid"),
    all = FALSE
  )
  n_irfinder_only_cells <- nrow(irfinder_hc_key[
    !psi_key,
    on = .(suppa_id, uuid)
  ])

  matched_any_conf <- merge(
    psi_key,
    irfinder_all[, .(suppa_id, uuid, IRratio)],
    by = c("suppa_id", "uuid"),
    all = FALSE
  )

  event_concordance <- both[,
    .(
      r = if (.N >= 3) {
        cor(psi, IRratio, method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs")
      } else {
        NA_real_
      },
      n_samples = .N
    ),
    by = suppa_id
  ]
  fwrite(
    event_concordance,
    sprintf(
      "qc/irfinder_concordance_%s_%s.csv.gz",
      irfinder_tree,
      this_transcript_filter
    )
  )
  agg_r <- both[, cor(psi, IRratio, method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs")]
  agg_r_any_conf <- matched_any_conf[,
    cor(psi, IRratio, method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs")
  ]

  cat(sprintf(
    "Events: total=%d any_annotation=%d (%.1f%%) high_conf=%d (%.1f%%)\n",
    n_events_total,
    n_events_any_annotation,
    100 * n_events_any_annotation / n_events_total,
    n_events_high_conf,
    100 * n_events_high_conf / n_events_total
  ))
  cat(sprintf(
    "Cells: rMATS non-NA=%d, usable-high-conf-match=%d (%.1f%%), IRFinder-only=%d\n",
    nrow(psi_long),
    nrow(both),
    100 * nrow(both) / nrow(psi_long),
    n_irfinder_only_cells
  ))
  cat(sprintf(
    "Concordance: high-conf r=%.3f (n=%d); no-conf-filter r=%.3f (n=%d)\n",
    agg_r,
    nrow(both),
    agg_r_any_conf,
    nrow(matched_any_conf)
  ))

  fwrite(
    irfinder_only_recurring,
    sprintf("qc/irfinder_only_introns_%s_%s.csv.gz", irfinder_tree, this_transcript_filter)
  )
  append_sanity(
    sprintf("irfinder_only_introns_%s_%s", irfinder_tree, this_transcript_filter),
    "INFO", nrow(irfinder_only_recurring), NA_real_,
    sprintf(
      "tree=%s: %d genome-wide introns have recurring (>=3 sample) high-confidence IRFinder retention signal (IRratio>0.1) with NO rMATS RI candidate at that coordinate; %d of those WERE a pre-Procedure-2-filter rMATS candidate (filtered out, recoverable), %d were NEVER an rMATS RI candidate at all (no alternative isoform in the annotation)",
      irfinder_tree, nrow(irfinder_only_recurring), n_filtered_by_proc2, n_not_suppa_candidate
    )
  )

  list(
    tree = irfinder_tree,
    n_events_total = n_events_total,
    n_events_any_annotation = n_events_any_annotation,
    n_events_high_conf = n_events_high_conf,
    event_category = event_category,
    both = both,
    matched_any_conf = matched_any_conf,
    n_irfinder_only_cells = n_irfinder_only_cells,
    event_concordance = event_concordance,
    agg_r = agg_r,
    agg_r_any_conf = agg_r_any_conf,
    irfinder_only_recurring = irfinder_only_recurring,
    n_filtered_by_proc2 = n_filtered_by_proc2,
    n_not_suppa_candidate = n_not_suppa_candidate
  )
}

# Try BOTH trees for real, rather than assume the placeholder
# tsl_filtered->TSL12/else->annotation mapping is correct.
tree_results <- list(
  annotation = analyze_tree("annotation"),
  TSL12 = analyze_tree("TSL12")
)
```

```{r, tree-comparison}
# Which folder is actually the better match for THIS transcript_filter's
# rMATS event set? Compare both trees head-to-head instead of guessing.
tree_summary <- rbindlist(lapply(tree_results, function(res) {
  data.table(
    tree = res$tree,
    events_any_annotation = res$n_events_any_annotation,
    events_high_conf = res$n_events_high_conf,
    pct_high_conf = 100 * res$n_events_high_conf / res$n_events_total,
    n_matched_cells = nrow(res$both),
    concordance_r = res$agg_r,
    concordance_r_no_conf_filter = res$agg_r_any_conf,
    irfinder_only_introns = nrow(res$irfinder_only_recurring),
    irfinder_only_filtered_by_proc2 = res$n_filtered_by_proc2,
    irfinder_only_never_suppa_candidate = res$n_not_suppa_candidate
  )
}))
print(tree_summary)
fwrite(
  tree_summary,
  sprintf("qc/irfinder_tree_comparison_%s.csv.gz", this_transcript_filter)
)

for (tn in names(tree_results)) {
  res <- tree_results[[tn]]
  append_sanity(
    sprintf("irfinder_exact_match_frac_%s_%s", tn, this_transcript_filter),
    ifelse(res$n_events_high_conf / res$n_events_total > 0.5, "PASS", "WARN"),
    res$n_events_high_conf / res$n_events_total,
    0.5,
    sprintf(
      "tree=%s: %d/%d rMATS RI events have >=1 high-confidence IRFinder cell",
      tn,
      res$n_events_high_conf,
      res$n_events_total
    )
  )
  append_sanity(
    sprintf("irfinder_rmats_concordance_%s_%s", tn, this_transcript_filter),
    ifelse(res$agg_r > 0.5, "PASS", "WARN"),
    res$agg_r,
    0.5,
    sprintf(
      "tree=%s: aggregate Spearman r=%.3f (n=%d matched high-confidence cells); r=%.3f without confidence filter (n=%d)",
      tn,
      res$agg_r,
      nrow(res$both),
      res$agg_r_any_conf,
      nrow(res$matched_any_conf)
    )
  )
}

# Do the two trees agree on WHICH events are high-confidence? Direct evidence
# for/against the annotation<->transcript_filter mapping guess.
cat_compare <- merge(
  tree_results$annotation$event_category[, .(
    suppa_id,
    cat_annotation = category
  )],
  tree_results$TSL12$event_category[, .(suppa_id, cat_TSL12 = category)],
  by = "suppa_id"
)
category_agreement_tab <- table(
  cat_compare$cat_annotation,
  cat_compare$cat_TSL12
)
print(category_agreement_tab)
agreement_frac <- mean(cat_compare$cat_annotation == cat_compare$cat_TSL12)
cat(sprintf(
  "Event-category agreement between annotation and TSL12 trees: %.1f%%\n",
  100 * agreement_frac
))
append_sanity(
  sprintf("irfinder_tree_category_agreement_%s", this_transcript_filter),
  "INFO",
  agreement_frac,
  NA_real_,
  sprintf(
    "fraction of RI events with the SAME found-by-IRFinder category (rmats_only/annotated_never_confident/high_conf) in both annotation and TSL12 trees; annotation high_conf=%d, TSL12 high_conf=%d, concordance r annotation=%.3f TSL12=%.3f",
    tree_results$annotation$n_events_high_conf,
    tree_results$TSL12$n_events_high_conf,
    tree_results$annotation$agg_r,
    tree_results$TSL12$agg_r
  )
)

# Use the tree with higher concordance (more real signal, not just more
# matches) as "primary" for the stratified metrics/plots below - report both
# regardless.
primary_tree <- names(tree_results)[
  which.max(sapply(tree_results, function(r) r$agg_r))
]
cat(sprintf(
  "Higher-concordance tree for %s: %s (r=%.3f vs %.3f)\n",
  this_transcript_filter,
  primary_tree,
  tree_results[[primary_tree]]$agg_r,
  tree_results[[setdiff(names(tree_results), primary_tree)]]$agg_r
))
```

```{r, stratified-metrics}
# Does WHETHER an event is found by IRFinder (and at what confidence) track
# any intrinsic property of the event - coverage, intron length, PSI level,
# PSI variability? Answers "why aren't they [found]" with data, not a guess.
strat_summary <- rbindlist(lapply(names(tree_results), function(tn) {
  ec <- tree_results[[tn]]$event_category
  dt <- merge(event_metrics, ec, by = "suppa_id")
  dt[, tree := tn]
  dt
}))

metric_cols <- c(
  "mean_coverage",
  "intron_length",
  "mean_psi",
  "sd_psi",
  "n_samples"
)
strat_table <- strat_summary[,
  lapply(.SD, median, na.rm = TRUE),
  by = .(tree, category),
  .SDcols = metric_cols
]
setorder(strat_table, tree, category)
print(strat_table)
fwrite(
  strat_table,
  sprintf("qc/irfinder_stratified_metrics_%s.csv.gz", this_transcript_filter)
)

# Kruskal-Wallis across the 3 categories per metric per tree - is the
# difference actually significant, or just noise?
kw_results <- rbindlist(lapply(names(tree_results), function(tn) {
  dt <- strat_summary[tree == tn]
  rbindlist(lapply(metric_cols, function(m) {
    kw <- kruskal.test(dt[[m]] ~ dt$category)
    data.table(tree = tn, metric = m, kw_p = kw$p.value)
  }))
}))
print(kw_results)

for (i in seq_len(nrow(kw_results))) {
  append_sanity(
    sprintf(
      "irfinder_stratified_%s_%s_%s",
      kw_results$tree[i],
      kw_results$metric[i],
      this_transcript_filter
    ),
    ifelse(kw_results$kw_p[i] < 0.05, "INFO", "INFO"),
    kw_results$kw_p[i],
    0.05,
    sprintf(
      "Kruskal-Wallis p=%.3g for %s across found-by-IRFinder category (rmats_only/annotated_never_confident/high_conf), tree=%s",
      kw_results$kw_p[i],
      kw_results$metric[i],
      kw_results$tree[i]
    )
  )
}
```

```{r, plots}
library(ggplot2)
for (tn in names(tree_results)) {
  res <- tree_results[[tn]]

  p_hist <- ggplot(res$event_concordance[!is.na(r)], aes(x = r)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "steelblue", color = "white") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
    labs(
      title = sprintf(
        "Per-event Spearman(rMATS PSI, IRFinder IRratio) - %s (tree=%s)",
        this_transcript_filter,
        tn
      ),
      x = "Spearman r",
      y = "count"
    )
  print(p_hist)
  ggsave(
    sprintf(
      "qc/distributions/irfinder_concordance_%s_%s.pdf",
      tn,
      this_transcript_filter
    ),
    p_hist,
    width = 7,
    height = 5
  )

  p_scatter <- ggplot(
    res$both[sample.int(.N, min(.N, 20000))],
    aes(x = psi, y = IRratio)
  ) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.15, size = 0.5) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "red") +
    labs(
      title = sprintf(
        "rMATS RI PSI vs IRFinder IRratio (pooled r=%.3f) - %s (tree=%s)",
        res$agg_r,
        this_transcript_filter,
        tn
      ),
      x = "rMATS RI PSI",
      y = "IRFinder IRratio"
    )
  print(p_scatter)
  ggsave(
    sprintf(
      "qc/distributions/irfinder_scatter_%s_%s.pdf",
      tn,
      this_transcript_filter
    ),
    p_scatter,
    width = 6,
    height = 6
  )
}

# Stratified plots: does the found-by-IRFinder category track intrinsic
# event properties? One plot per metric, faceted by tree. Only intron_length
# and mean_coverage are strictly-positive, wide-dynamic-range metrics that
# benefit from log scale; mean_psi/sd_psi are bounded [0,1] (often exactly 0)
# and n_samples is a small count - log10(0) = -Inf would silently drop rows.
log_scale_metrics <- c("mean_coverage", "intron_length")
for (m in metric_cols) {
  p <- ggplot(strat_summary, aes(x = category, y = .data[[m]])) +
    geom_violin(fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, outlier.size = 0.3) +
    facet_wrap(~tree) +
    labs(
      title = sprintf(
        "%s by found-by-IRFinder category - %s",
        m,
        this_transcript_filter
      ),
      x = "category",
      y = m
    ) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))
  if (m %in% log_scale_metrics) {
    p <- p + scale_y_log10()
  }
  print(p)
  ggsave(
    sprintf(
      "qc/distributions/irfinder_stratified_%s_%s.pdf",
      m,
      this_transcript_filter
    ),
    p,
    width = 8,
    height = 5
  )
}
```
